items.title: 2026北京智源大会开幕 | 从“悟道”到“悟界”，智源研究院推动人工智能、物理世界和生命科学“三体互动”
items.raw_excerpt: 2026年6月12日，第八届“北京智源大会”在中关村国际创新中心开幕。 北京智源大会是智源研究院主办的“AI内行学术盛会”，以“技术前沿、国际视野、青年人才”为特色，汇聚海内外研究者分享研究成果、探寻前沿知识、交流实践经验。本届大会，现代数字安全体系奠基者Whitfield Diffie线下参会，聚焦Agent时代的安全与可信挑战；强化学习奠基人Andrew Barto追问“交互驱动智能”对于下一代AI系统的意义。30余位30岁以下青年科学家，40余位AI企业CEO、创始人与首席科学家，200余位顶尖专家学者将齐聚北京，中国AI产业世界模型与Agent领域最具代表性的创新力量首次集中同台。20余家全球顶尖科技企业及高校科研机构，包括Meta、英伟达、哈佛、MIT等，将与阿里、腾讯、小米、生数科技、面壁智能、清华、北大、人大等中国AI行业最核心的 创新力量同场交流。同时，大会还汇聚数百位全球AI领域学术中坚力量，一同围绕世界模型、通用智能体、具身智能、AI安全、AI Native教育、Token经济与OPC、智能计算底层架构等前沿方向展开精彩演讲和前瞻性对话。 开幕式由智源研究院理事长黄铁军主持。 智源研究院院长王仲远做2026年研究进展报告，发布智源研究院在基座大模型、智能体、基础软硬件生态等前沿技术领域的探索成果和开源生态建设的最新动态。 自2018年成立以来，智源研究院先后发布了“悟道”系列大模型和“悟界”系列大模型，构建了自底向上的全栈大模型开源技术体系。无论是在大模型发展的早期，还是在物理AI的全新时期，智源研究院始终在引领人工智能大模型的前沿研究探索。截至目前，智源开源模型超200个，全球总下载量累计超过10亿次。同时也孵化了一系列在大模型领域和具身智能领域非常具有代表性的创新创业企业。 2024年智源大会上，智源发布了对于人工智能尤其是大模型技术的演化路径的预判

excerpt_i18n.en:
The 2026 FIFA World Cup in the United States, Canada, and Mexico is approaching. Today, Qianwen held the launch salon for its first football prediction AI assistant. Users are invited to predict match scores to earn points. Participants can not only help Qianwen donate football fields to rural schools but also have the chance to win a cash prize of 10,000 yuan.  

Qianwen Launches Football Prediction AI Assistant  
The first football prediction AI assistant has been launched, integrating big data such as weather and terrain. This will be the first World Cup where AI fully participates in match predictions. Qianwen’s football prediction AI assistant is now open to all users. Cheng Fei, head of Qianwen’s AI prediction product, explained that the assistant is trained on vast amounts of big data, including historical data, player statistics, injury conditions, and even terrain data of the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, as well as weather data during match periods.  

Using the example of the group stage match between Norway and Senegal on June 22, Cheng Fei noted that Norway, with world-class striker Erling Haaland, seems likely to win. However, Qianwen predicted a 1-1 draw.  

“The reason for this prediction is the weather,” Cheng Fei explained. “Since this World Cup is hosted by three countries, the weather conditions for different matches can vary significantly. Qianwen takes into account the temperature, humidity, kickoff time, and the typical playing environments of both teams.” Similarly, the opening match between Mexico and South Africa is also influenced by weather and altitude. Qianwen predicts a Mexican victory, not only due to home-field advantage but also because of the special factor of Mexico City’s altitude of over 2,200 meters.
excerpt_i18n.es: La Copa del Mundo 2026, que se celebrará en Estados Unidos, México y Canadá, está a punto de comenzar. Los participantes no solo podrán contribuir con Qianwen a donar campos de fútbol a escuelas rurales, sino que también tendrán la oportunidad de ganar un premio en efectivo de 10,000 yuanes. Qianwen lanza su asistente de IA para predicciones futbolísticas, el primero de su tipo, que integra macrodatos como el clima y la geografía. Esta es la primera Copa del Mundo en la que la IA participa plenamente en las apuestas. Qianwen ha puesto a disposición de todos los usuarios este asistente de IA para predicciones futbolísticas. Cheng Fei, responsable del producto de predicciones de IA de Qianwen, explicó que el asistente se basa en el entrenamiento con grandes volúmenes de datos, que incluyen no solo datos históricos, sino también diversos factores.

excerpt_i18n.en: Over the past six months, the "lobster fever" sparked by OpenClaw has plunged the AI community into collective euphoria: AI writing code for you, replying to emails, even taking over devices, as if the countdown to "replacing humans" has already begun. Nvidia's Jensen Huang called it "one of the most important software releases ever," adding fuel to the frenzy. But as the bubble slightly deflates, the IoT industry is left with awkward cracks on the beach. An accidental email deletion in a company's lab, a source code leak at another firm, and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology's March advisory on preventing security risks from OpenClaw ("Lobster") open-source intelligent agents all remind us: when general-purpose agents pursue "omniscience and omnipotence," they often come with the risk of losing control. For IoT developers, the reality is even harsher—private protocols pile up, documentation is incomplete, and even if AI can write functional code in 15 minutes, the tedious testing and release processes can still stretch delivery cycles to days. excerpt_i18n.es: En los últimos seis meses, la "fiebre de la langosta" provocada por OpenClaw ha sumido a la comunidad de IA en una euforia colectiva: la IA escribe código por ti, responde correos electrónicos e incluso toma el control de dispositivos, como si la cuenta atrás para "reemplazar a los humanos" ya hubiera comenzado.
